title: Anti-cargo-cult check contract (L29)
description: Adversarial held-out probe gate before canary promotion. See ADR-034.

invariants.name: yaml_pinned_probe_set
invariants.description: Probes live at configs/anti_cargo_cult_probes.yaml. Loaded once at gate-init.
must: yaml_path = configs/anti_cargo_cult_probes.yaml exactly
loaded at AntiCargoCultGate.__init__ via yaml.CSafeLoader
load failure -> ERROR + gate disabled (fail-closed via explicit operator alert)

invariants.name: required_probe_fields_present
invariants.description: Every probe has probe_id, probe_version, input, expected_class, baseline_accuracy, added_at_utc, added_by.
must: all 7 required_probe_fields present
missing field -> probe rejected on load with WARNING (continue with other probes)
no silent default-filling

invariants.name: tolerance_bound
invariants.description: tolerance_pct default 5. Tunable in [0, 20] range. Promotion blocked when candidate < baseline - tolerance.
must: default 5%
validator rejects tolerance outside [0, 20]
block condition: candidate_accuracy < (baseline_accuracy - tolerance_pct/100)

invariants.name: block_on_tolerance_fail
invariants.description: Promotion is BLOCKED (not just penalized) when candidate falls below baseline - tolerance.
must: promotion gate returns BLOCK status on tolerance fail
no fallthrough to next gate -- this gate is dispositive when it fails
BLOCK status logged with probe_ids that failed

invariants.name: no_silent_probe_removal
invariants.description: Removing a probe requires explicit YAML diff with removed_reason comment.
must: implementation has no auto-prune for active entries
removing a probe is a manual YAML edit + commit
removed entries should have a removed_at_utc + removed_reason field in version control

invariants.name: stable_tag_for_stale_probes
invariants.description: Probes with no candidate failures in 90 days get stable: true tag. Tagged still run but deprioritized.
must: stable_tag_after_days_clean default 90
stable=true probes still evaluated, just listed last in gate order
no probe is dropped from active rotation by tagging alone

invariants.name: probe_versioning
invariants.description: Each probe has probe_id + probe_version. Editing increments version; probe_id stable.
must: probe_id stable across edits
probe_version monotone increment on edit
candidate evaluation records (probe_id, probe_version) for traceability
